card.title: I Know the Procedure
card.instruction: Perform investigative confidence while quietly using each response to discover what the questions, clues, and next steps should be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As building manager, I'll establish why this door won't lock. Describe the anomaly.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The hinge is loose. I usually tighten it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Precisely. Show me your usual method so I can assess it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll need the screwdriver from your desk.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, we've reached the tool stage. Which drawer do you normally find it in?

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 investigative formality, A3 precisely and A5 tool stage conceal learning the method and screwdriver location from B.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 hinge diagnosis leads A3 to request demonstration; B4 tool at A's desk leads A5 to ask the drawer.

relationship.evidence: B2 has repaired it before and B4 knows the needed tool, giving B practical expertise that shapes A's procedure.

heightening.evidence: B4 locates the tool at A's own desk; A5 must ask a still more basic question while claiming procedural progress.

specificity.evidence: A1 building manager and nonlocking door, B2 hinge and B4 screwdriver make the competence gap playable.
